items.statement: A defensible reproduction characterizes minima by zero imaginary frequencies and the selected transition state by one imaginary frequency, with TS connectivity checked by IRC or an explicitly justified equivalent.
items.expected: The submission reports frequency counts and per-candidate connectivity evidence, including a one-imaginary-frequency TS and a connection toward the two neighboring states.

items.statement: The authors' validated redox-neutral profile has an energy span/free-energy barrier of 29.2 kcal mol−1.
items.expected: Reported span is approximately 29.2 kcal mol−1 under the submission's stated convention.

items.statement: The reported route retains Zn(II) and proceeds through nucleophilic coupling-partner activation followed by alkynyl-halide activation/product formation.
items.expected: The selected route description supports a redox-neutral Zn(II) interpretation and the stated ordered chemistry.
